subject: 64h runway: quick numbers check, flags, and action runbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-12-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: 64h runway: quick numbers check, flags, and action runbook

Team —

We have a compressed cadence for this week: finance wants a deterministic signal on accounts likely to slip beyond the 64-hour runway (i.e., deals with no committed activity or approvals in the next 48 hours). Please treat this as our single-source checklist for the next 64 hours. I’m asking for two things by 11:30 PT: a) quick stage-confirm for your assigned accounts, b) any blockers that require an escalation.

One-page runbook attached (64h_runway_scorecard.pdf) and a pulse spreadsheet (AVY_Q4_forecast_pulse.xlsx). Action items below — keep replies short.

Immediate asks:
- Update stage to the most defensible single value (PROBABLE / COMMITTED / AT-RISK) in the sheet for each assigned account.
- Add one-line rationale if you mark AT-RISK.
- If a contract/PO is pending but awaiting procurement signature, flag as "Awaiting PO (procurement)" and include estimated sig date.
- If you need finance approval for credit or unusual billing terms, call out the dollar amount and the reason.

Pre-call cadence (stand-up at 15:00 PT):
- 15:00–15:10: quick triage of the red list (accounts without activity in 48h)
- 15:10–15:25: owner action plan & next-step assignment
- 15:25–15:30: escalation handoff (who’s looping Legal/Finance/CS)

Please reply with "ACK + done" when you’ve updated your rows. I’ll fold the scoreboard into the 3pm call deck.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: 64h_runway_scorecard.pdf (1 page runbook)
Attachment: AVY_Q4_forecast_pulse.xlsx (sheet: owner_assignments)

ACK + done.

Notes:
- AVY-41: moved to COMMITTED — legal cleanup only, expected signed by Mon 12/13 (procurement already approved).
- AVY-87: marked AT-RISK — awaiting decision from their CFO; no demo in last 10 days. Rishi, asking you to own outreach.
- AVY-92: Awaiting PO (procurement) — contact Jordan Hale (ccing) to confirm expected PO date. I left a 1-line rationale column populated in the sheet.

I’ll join the 15:00 triage. If anyone wants to pre-sync, ping me.

—Grace
